collection.title: DS DS7 Crossback 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A DS7 Crossback 2017 Onwards requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" blade on the passengers side, however some brands recommend 28" & 16". All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this DS7 Crossback  which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
